title: XIRR: a live Value2 replay and a bit-for-bit witness, on no named Excel build
status_plain: XIRR was replayed against live Excel through Range.Value2 and, after the repair, returns the same f64 bits as Excel on the pinned witness. The disclosure that matters most here is an absence: BUG-FUNC-014 names no Excel build anywhere in the document. Not in the 2026-04 replay, not in the widened-matrix work, not in the cell-reference resweep. XIRR's only bit-exactness claim therefore has an unnamed oracle build, which is recorded as not-stated-in-this-record rather than filled by inference from a sibling stream. The second thing the stream is honest about is that the publication rule was not identified: the widened matrix rules out every simple explanatory rule tried. So XIRR matches its pinned witness set; it is not identified.

counts.build_note: BUG-FUNC-014 names NO Excel build anywhere in the document. A search for build numbers, for the string "build", for "16.0", and for any architecture or CPU string returns nothing. This is a genuine gap, not a formatting accident, and no build may be inherited from a sibling stream to fill it.
